title: Rujira Ecosystem
description: The Rujira ecosystem is continuously growing, this is an overview of all the dApps, protocols, products and services calling Rujira their home.
namiEarnDesc: Earning is for Everyone. Non-Custodial institutional-grade strategies, for optimized single sided yield without impermanent loss. Simplified for everyday users. Earning crypto with your crypto has never been this accessible.
namiIndexDesc: Diversify your portfolio in just one click. Instantly access a wide range of on-chain indexes that track your favorite protocols and investment themes. Simple, powerful, and tailored to your crypto strategy.
liquidyDesc: Liquidy is a Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) running a series of online revenue streams for $LQDY token holders. The first revenue streams is Market Making on RUJI Trade orderbook. The second revenue stream is a swap router on Rujira.
autoRujiraDesc: Simplifying your DeFi journey with streamlined, automated web3 operations. Manage investments and strategies seamlessly from one platform. A host of automation tools empowering everyone to maximize portfolio returns.
calcDesc: A powerful decentralized platform offering a range of recurring, customisable swap strategies. Set-and-forget investment mechanisms take the emotion out of decision making and let your portfolio do the work so you can spend more time on the things you love.
coralDesc: An entry and exit ramp for Rujira users built for simplicity and speed, forgoing the formalities of the traditional financial world. A secure platform for crypto users to connect with others and exchange tokens for fiat in a decentralized manner.
daodaoDesc: Create a DAO to manage your treasury, community, protocol, or entire blockchain in just a few clicks. DAODAO support multisig, token-based, and NFT-based DAOs that can be as simple or complex as you want.
vultisigDesc: Get best-in-class security from the most secure crypto wallet ever built, powered by the technology protecting multimillion dollar vaults on Thorchain. Perfect for individuals, DAOs and Teams seeking multi-sig functionality.
keplrDesc: A secure, open-source browser extension and mobile app wallet supporting multiple chains. Key features include multichain account management, staking, voting, and hardware wallet support.
braveDesc: Brave Wallet is a secure crypto wallet, built right into the Brave privacy browser. No extension required.
coinbaseDesc: Coinbase Wallet is a self-custody crypto wallet, putting you in control of your crypto, keys, and data. Now you can safely store your crypto and rare NFTs in one place.
ctrlDesc: The safest, easiest wallet for over 2,300 chains. Import addresses, swap and bridge tokens and NFTs, and manage gas fees across multiple chains. Audited by FYEO.
leapDesc: Supports 70+ Cosmos chains and offers address management, simplified chain management and 100% non-custodial security. Extensions for Chrome, Edge and Brave, and apps on iOS and Android are available. Audited by Halborn. Staking, single-click reward claims and airdrops updated in-wallet.
metamaskDesc: An Ethereum wallet trusted by millions. Browser extensions for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave and Opera, or iOS and Android app. Customization available using community-built Snaps. Manage your portfolio through their web portal.
okxDesc: A universal wallet available on app, web, and extension. Easily access 3,000+ crypto, 80+ networks, thousands of DApps, and the Web3 ecosystem. Supports EVM and non-EVM networks.
rabbyDesc: Rabby Wallet is an open-source browser plugin and mobile app for the DeFi ecosystem, providing users with a better-to-use and more secure multi-chain experience.
tonkeeperDesc: Tonkeeper is your very personal wallet. Receive, buy and spend crypto with ease.
trustDesc: A multi-chain wallet with over 140 million users. Available as a browser extension and mobile app. Integrated with Coinbase Pay and Binance Pay. Offers proactive risk notifications and multi-lingual support. Private Keys stored on your device and encrypted with an AES algorithm.
xamanDesc: The All-in-One XRP Ledger & Xahau Experience. Managing your non custodial accounts & tokens was never this easy. With an entire ecosystem & integrations available in Xaman, you'll have total freedom managing and using your native assets and any other issued token / currency on the supported XRP Ledger protocol networks.
halbornDesc: Providers of Blockchain Security, from smart contract auditing and pen testing to advisory services and beyond. They are dedicated to securing blockchain-powered projects through a range of enterprise-grade SaaS solutions and security advisory services used to identify and rectify vulnerabilities.
zellicDesc: A background in real-world offensive security, traditional info-sec and competitive hacking helps this team find what others miss. Specializing in securing emerging technologies, they offer a full vulnerability research process, assigning multiple engineers per engagement to ensure quality control.
fyeoDesc: FYEO has some of the world's leading experts in DeFi logic to test and analyze systems for potential vulnerabilities. Their services include comprehensive code, logic, and functionality review for implementations of advanced cryptographic or blockchain solutions.
kujiraTrackDesc: A single portal to crucial data about the performance of the Kujira ecosystem. View graphs, charts and information about the health of the blockchain in real time.
smartStakeDesc: Smart Stake benefits the Kujira community by sharing an immense amount of information about the blockchain. This includes blockchain statistics, decentralisation data, Validator and network performance, among other data points.
seaShantyDesc: Receive real-time notifications in Telegram from this bot for orders on FIN, proposals on Blue, and liquidations on ORCA. SeaShanty provides updates for several KUJIRA dApps, and other useful info.
cosmoBotDesc: Cosmobot helps and protects communities. It removes scammers and spammers from Telegram chats. It provides information, through a number of #commands. Users may also send a #tip to another chat group member to show appreciation.
kujiKastDesc: These Youtube creators make videos covering the Kujira ecosystem. Using skits, interviews and controversial hot takes, they blend shrewd insight with irreverent humour. Wink if you get it.
krakenDesc: Trade KUJI / USD and KUJI / EUR on Kraken Pro.
mexcDesc: Trade KUJI / USDT on the global MEXC exchange.
axelarDesc: Axelar's infrastructure enables dApp users to interact with any asset or application on the Kujira network with a few simple clicks.
squidDesc: This is key integration with the Sonar wallet. Squid allows any token to be swapped between Kujira & another blockchain. This unlocks access to apps on any chain in a single click.
kadoDesc: Users onboard onto Kujira directly from a bank account or card. Kado makes moving from fiat to crypto fast, convenient and secure.
stargazeDesc: An official NFT partner of Kujira. Stargaze has hosted a series of mints including KujiransNFT, Kujira Hero, Shrimp Gang & more to come. All of these are available on their marketplace.
rangoDesc: An incredibly easy way to onramp onto Kujira. Use Rango to trade $KUJI between 50+ blockchains with minimum effort.
rocketxDesc: Whether you want to swap $ETH to $KUJI, $ARB to $KUJI, or an array of other swaps, RocketX allows you to exchange on all leading blockchains, without any hassle.
erisDesc: Eris has brought the first Liquid Staked Token to the Kujira network. Deposited $KUJI in the Eris vaults to mint $ampKUJI & periodically the real yield staking rewards are swapped to more $KUJI.
strideDesc: A Cosmos chain providing Liquid Staking Derivatives such as $stATOM. Stride's LSDs have various uses on Kujira, including trading on FIN, providing LP on BOW & minting $USK.
mayaDesc: Maya Protocol allows native swaps of assets such as $BTC, $ETH & more across the Kujira ecosystem.
defiLlamaDesc: DefiLlama provides the community with the means to track and analyse important metrics including TVL for the chain and dApps built on Kujira.
gravityDesc: A key bridge partner of Kujira. Assets like $PAXG are bridged to Kujira by using Gravity and used as collateral for minting $USK. Gravity is also used to bridge KUJI onto Ethereum.
nomicDesc: Nomic allows dApp users to securely & efficiently bridge their BTC to Kujira using IBC. $NBTC will be a collateral option offered to mint $USK.
coinhallDesc: Coinhall enables users to track the price of assets on Kujira, set limit orders to buy and sell, or market buy trading pairs.
funtasticDesc: Funttastic Labs are building Hummingbot adaptors for FIN, which will enable anyone to create and activate high-frequency crypto trading bots on Kujira.
nansenDesc: Nansen Portfolio is a great tool to track your Kujira holdings. Includes staking, as well as positions on BOW, ORCA & other Kujira dApps.
coinwebDesc: Coinweb's consensus-free interoperable protocol allows developers to build dApps and for anyone to issue tokens on Kujira. The Coinweb Wallet will also support Kujira tokens.
pulsarDesc: An all-in-one interface to manage your assets across the Kujira network and the entire Cosmos.
